description: Iteration-1's converge review (reviews/converge/output/notes.md, criterion-4 row) explicitly recorded a non-blocking staleness: specs/verification-architecture.md still describes behavioral-spec.md section 2.5's transition matrix as '9-row' (an iteration-4-era row count) though the matrix was expanded to 12 rows by the iteration-5 spec-review precision fix, and verification-report.md itself correctly says '12-row' (verification-report.md:139: '## Section 2.5 Transition-matrix coverage (behavioral-spec.md, the authoritative exhaustive 12-row table)'). Iteration-1's own written recommendation explicitly asked for this to be corrected in the same doc-sync pass ('...and updating the stale "9-row" references to "12-row"'). The fix commit (3f657ba4) did not apply this part of the recommendation: specs/verification-architecture.md still reads '9-row' in 4 places (lines 42, 316, 343, 360), independently re-confirmed this session by direct grep. This remains a real, citable cross-artifact contradiction (verification-architecture.md's own '9-row' vs. behavioral-spec.md's actual 12-row table vs. verification-report.md's correct '12-row' citation) -- not a new regression, but a known, previously-disclosed gap that survived a fix pass whose own stated recommendation covered it.

evidence.snippet: See §2.5 of behavioral-spec.md for the exhaustive 9-row transition matrix this correction is verified against.
